ch0366_00_zagirl/0101_0701_02_10: If you’ve got time, let’s stroll through town!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7101_0701_01_10:
Visiting cafés is my life’s work! When I’m
traveling, I always look for nice ones to
check out!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7101_0701_02_10:
Relaxing at a café, taking photos with
Pokémon on my Rotom Phone... It’s the best!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7102_0701_01_10:
Lumiose City has loads of tall buildings!
You can discover so many things just by
looking up while you walk!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7102_0701_02_10:
But Pasio has more nature, and people and
Pokémon seem more at ease here.
ch0366_00_zagirl/7102_0701_03_10:
Whenever I spot those little differences
between places, it makes me happy.
ch0366_00_zagirl/7103_0701_01_10:
I always check on my Pokémon before my
morning walk through town.
ch0366_00_zagirl/7103_0701_02_10:
If they have the energy, we take the long
way! If they’re tired, we rest on a bench.
ch0366_00_zagirl/7104_0701_01_10:
Sightseeing here is fun, but I wonder what
I can do for Pasio.
ch0366_00_zagirl/7104_0701_02_10:
As a member of Team MZ, I want to keep
finding ways I can support everyone!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7105_0701_01_10:
Where do you typically buy your clothes,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]? They’re so
uniquely you. It’s a great look!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7105_0701_02_10:
I’d love if you could take me shopping there
sometime!
ch0366_00_zagirl/7105_0701_03_10: Let’s explore nearby cafés while we’re at it!
ch0366_00_zagirl/1701_0701_01_10: Hey, do you have a second?
ch0366_00_zagirl/1701_0701_02_10:
I found something that might be useful.
Here you go!
ch0366_00_zagirl/1701_0702_01_10: If I find anything else, I’ll share!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2501_0701_01_10:
I tend to talk tough before Pokémon battles
to hype myself.
ch0366_00_zagirl/2501_0701_02_10:
After all, I want to give everything I’ve got
without losing my nerve!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2501_0702_01_10:
Hey, wanna enter the Z-A Royale? I bet you
could aim for the top!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2501_0702_02_10:
If we end up facing off, we’ll have to battle
it out—fair and square!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2511_0701_01_10:
My favorite coffee is Nouveau Café’s
Ember Roast!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2511_0701_02_10:
Urbain recommended it, and now it’s all
I drink.
ch0366_00_zagirl/2511_0702_01_10: Come hang out in Lumiose City someday!
ch0366_00_zagirl/2511_0702_02_10: There are tons of shops I’d love to show you!
ch0366_00_zagirl/3001_0701_01_10:
Hey! Let’s grab a morning coffee and have
a chat!
ch0366_00_zagirl/3003_0701_01_10:
Hello! Wanna go for a walk around town?
We might find some cool items!
ch0366_00_zagirl/3005_0701_01_10:
When night falls, I feel a bit restless. Maybe
it’s ’cause I took part in the Z-A Royale!
